questions.example: Which Incoterms will you use for this shipment, FOB or CIF?
questions.exampleZh: 這批貨你們會用哪種國際貿易條件，FOB 還是 CIF？

questions.example: Please show the country of origin on the invoice.
questions.exampleZh: 請在發票上標明原產地。

questions.example: Can you make a partial shipment first and send the rest next week?
questions.exampleZh: 可以先分批出一部分，剩下的下週再寄嗎？

questions.example: We had to cancel the order because the price was too high.
questions.exampleZh: 因為價格太高，我們只好取消訂單。

questions.example: This quote is over our budget. Can you give us a better price?
questions.exampleZh: 這個報價超出我們的預算，可以給更好的價格嗎？

questions.example: The items were damaged, so we asked for a full refund.
questions.exampleZh: 商品損壞了，所以我們要求全額退款。

questions.example: Please send a replacement for the broken parts as soon as possible.
questions.exampleZh: 請盡快寄送損壞零件的替換品。

questions.prompt: 情境：看不懂供應商信裡的某個條款，想請對方說明清楚，最自然的說法是？
options: Could you clarify what you mean by this term?
You clarify me this term please.
questions.example: Could you clarify what you mean by "net 30"?
questions.exampleZh: 可以說明一下你說的「月結 30 天」是什麼意思嗎？

questions.prompt: 情境：貨到了預定日期還沒收到，要寫信問廠商，最自然的說法是？
options: We didn't receive yet the goods.
We haven't received the goods yet. Could you check the status?
questions.example: We haven't received the goods yet. Could you check the status?
questions.exampleZh: 我們還沒收到貨，可以幫忙查一下狀態嗎？

questions.prompt: 情境：事情拖了一陣子終於處理好，想感謝對方耐心等待，最自然的說法是？
questions.example: Thank you for your patience. The new parts will arrive tomorrow.
questions.exampleZh: 謝謝您耐心等候，新零件明天會到。
